workMap.task: Submit meal expenses in Ledgerline so finance accepts them first time
gaps: Who can approve when the supervisor is away?

steps.title: Open the month's report and add a Meals / Drinks expense
steps.reason: Every meal goes into the month's food report.
steps.expertQuote: First, I'm going to enter some food expenses.

steps.title: Restaurant meal: attach the receipt and submit
steps.reason: Sit-down restaurant receipts are already tax-compliant; nothing else is needed under $30 per person.
steps.expertQuote: Those were sit-down restaurant receipts. Those are already tax-compliant on their own, they have all the detail built in.

steps.title: Over $30 per person: attach the supervisor's approval
steps.decision: Attached a screenshot of the supervisor's approval to the $40 dinner, but not to the $25 lunch
steps.reason: Above $30 per person finance needs proof the supervisor signed off; under $30 you submit it yourself.
steps.expertQuote: Over $30 a person, I need proof my supervisor actually signed off. A screenshot of an email or a chat works, as long as it shows the date, the amount and who was there. Under $30, I don't need that at all.
guardrails: Over $30 per person without the supervisor's written approval: don't submit.
The approval must show the date, the amount and who was there.

steps.title: Delivery orders: attach both the receipt and the downloaded invoice
steps.decision: Uploaded the Bitebox receipt and the tax invoice downloaded from the app
steps.reason: The app receipt only shows what was paid; the invoice has the VAT breakdown finance needs and must be downloaded separately.
steps.expertQuote: They do different jobs. The receipt just shows what I paid. It's not tax-compliant on its own. The invoice has the actual VAT breakdown finance needs, and it doesn't come to me automatically. So for this one, I always upload both.
guardrails: Delivery app order with only the receipt: download the invoice before submitting.

steps.title: Restaurant receipts don't need the extra invoice step
steps.decision: Did not download a separate invoice for the two restaurant meals
steps.reason: Only delivery apps give a receipt that isn't enough on its own.
steps.expertQuote: It's really only Uber Eats and other delivery apps where the default receipt isn't enough and I have to go get the invoice separately.

steps.title: Save each expense and submit the report
steps.reason: The $30 per person line is the same everywhere; checked once more before submitting.
steps.expertQuote: Always the same. $30 a person is the line everywhere.
guardrails: $30 per person is the limit everywhere; it never changes.
